note: 1.6.0 (FW-0061): a pilot portal's tabs (contract 1). {name} is the pilot's name. Card types: the pilot's own card copies (custom:flight-watcher-<x>-card-{name}), heading, tile, entity, toggle and static markdown (text only, no templates). No tickets or uploads card. 1.6.2 (Release A item 13): the Watcher tab has the working flight, the open time pot and Tradeboard pickups and the CrewTrac charters card; the Schedule tab has the FLICA requests, where the Request decided alert opens. 1.6.2 review: no Hunt interval tile on the Settings tab (a pilot hunts at 120 s, which contract 1's 5 to 90 s cannot send; a markdown line says so) and no State, Last check or Next check rows under the clock card.

cards.content:
- **Scan FLICA now** reads the open time pot and the Tradeboard right away, and your schedule too unless a schedule read is backing off (the Schedule tab says when it tries next). It is a full check, so use it when you need it: at most one check starts every 2 min.
- **Hunt mode** checks about every 2 min (120 s, the fastest for a pilot); off is normal speed.
- Every wait varies by up to 30 % (never under 2 min), so FLICA never sees a fixed rhythm.
- **Pause** only if you log in to FLICA yourself for a long time. The Watcher also steps back on its own when it sees your login: 30 min, longer if you log in again within 6 h (up to 4 h).
- **Scan CrewTrac now** logs in to CrewTrac once to look for charters (at most one press every 30 min). If CrewTrac refuses your user ID or password, the Watcher stops trying until you save new CrewTrac details on the Settings tab.
- FLICA is read only: the Watcher never submits, drops, swaps, adds or bids. CrewTrac is read only too.
The Recall/O75 miss check follows the 2023 PWA, 22.G.2. A CCR is never filed for you from here: the card drafts the narrative only.
Hunt mode checks every 120 s (the fastest for a pilot).
